sloka: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तैराकाशं पक्षिभिर्वृतम् ।मनुष्यैरावृता भूमिरुभयं प्रबभौ तदा ॥ २.१०२.४४॥
transliteration: tena śabdena vitrastairākāśaṁ pakṣibhirvṛtam ।manuṣyairāvṛtā bhūmirubhayaṁ prababhau tadā ॥ 2.102.44॥

translations.english: The sky was filled with birds frightened by the sound and the earth covered with people. Both looked extremely beautiful.
